posts.name: Opus 5.5 Video Generator
posts.tagline: Turn a text prompt into a 1080p motion-graphics MP4
posts.hook: Opus 5.5 Video Generator creates animated videos from text descriptions. You write a short text prompt. The software then builds a high-definition motion-graphics video. Motion graphics are moving digital designs that combine shapes and text. The tool is for creators who want quick marketing or social media videos.
